description: This file defines an abstract class 'StreamSequenceToken' representing a stream sequence number/token, along with a static utility class for comparing tokens within the Orleans.Streams namespace. It is used within the Orleans framework for stream processing, handling stream event sequencing and comparison.

classes.name: StreamSequenceToken
classes.description: Abstract class representing a stream sequence number/token with comparison capabilities.

classes.name: StreamSequenceTokenUtilities
classes.description: Provides utility methods for comparing instances of StreamSequenceToken.

methods.name: Equals
methods.description: Abstract method to determine if another StreamSequenceToken is equal to this one.

methods.name: CompareTo
methods.description: Abstract method to compare this StreamSequenceToken with another for ordering.

methods.name: Newer
methods.description: Extension method to check if this token is newer than another.

methods.name: Older
methods.description: Extension method to check if this token is older than another.
